**DNA methylation age** (DNAmAge) estimated from CpG beta values diverges from chronological age in cancer - the **difference** (accelerated vs decelerated) is the epigenetic-age readout \[1\]. The reference uses ChAMP + `wateRmelon::agep()` on TCGA 450K data; the methylation processing is too heavy for this lockfile, so the tutorial **simulates the DNAmAge output** directly and reproduces the mirrored barplot in base graphics - for real data, run ChAMP first and skip straight to the plotting block:

```{r}
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")
```

## Data Preparation

Simulated DNAmAge output for 20 samples (sorted by descending difference): `dnamage`, `cage`, and their difference classified as accelerated (red) or decelerated (darkblue):

```{r load data}
set.seed(21501)
n_da <- 20
cage <- round(runif(n_da, 30, 75))
dnamage <- round(cage + rnorm(n_da, 8, 15), 1)
dnamage <- pmax(5, dnamage)
diff <- dnamage - cage
agestatus <- ifelse(diff > 0, "Accelerated", "Decelerated")
o <- order(diff, decreasing = TRUE)
da <- data.frame(cage = cage[o], dnamage = dnamage[o], diff = diff[o],
                 agestatus = agestatus[o], row.names = sprintf("S%02d", 1:n_da))
da$colr <- ifelse(da$agestatus == "Accelerated", adjustcolor("#E31A1C", 0.8),
                  adjustcolor("#1F78B4", 0.8))
```

## Visualization

### 1. Mirrored DNAmAge Barplot

The base-graphics mirrored barplot: DNAmAge bars extend upward from y = 0, chronological age bars extend downward, and the coloured difference bars overlay both:

```{r}
#| label: fig-1.1DnaAge
#| fig-cap: "Mirrored barplot of DNA methylation age vs chronological age for 20 simulated samples: upward bars = DNAmAge, downward bars = chronological age, coloured difference bars mark accelerated (red) vs decelerated (blue) samples."
#| out.width: "80%"
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.5

barplot(t(da[, c("dnamage", "cage")]), beside = FALSE,
        col = c("#99999940", "#66666640"), border = NA,
        ylim = c(-80, 150), axes = FALSE, xaxt = "n", space = 0.4)
axis(2, las = 1, cex.axis = 0.8)
barplot(da$diff, col = da$colr, add = TRUE, space = 0.4, axes = FALSE, xaxt = "n")
bp <- barplot(t(da[, c("dnamage", "cage")]), beside = FALSE,
        col = c("#99999940", "#66666640"), border = NA,
        ylim = c(-80, 150), axes = FALSE, xaxt = "n", space = 0.4)
lines(bp, lowess(da$diff)$y, lwd = 1.5, col = "grey20")
axis(1, at = seq(0.7, n_da, by = 2) + 0.4, labels = rownames(da)[seq(1, n_da, by = 2)],
     cex.axis = 0.65, tick = FALSE)
text(1, 120, "DNA methylation age", cex = 0.85, adj = 0, font = 2)
text(1, -70, "Chronological age", cex = 0.85, adj = 0, font = 2)
legend("topright", bty = "n", cex = 0.75, pch = 15,
       col = c(adjustcolor("#E31A1C", 0.8), adjustcolor("#1F78B4", 0.8)),
       legend = c("Accelerated", "Decelerated"))
```

::: callout-tip
**Practice tips**

-   `wateRmelon::agep()` uses Horvath 353-CpG coefficients by default; 450K covers all 353 CpGs.
-   The mirrored barplot uses `barplot(..., add = TRUE, space = 0)` twice with matching `space`.
-   DNAmAge acceleration correlates with chronic inflammation; validate before interpreting.
:::
